newsitem.title: USA: Texaco hires black-owned advertising agency.
newsitem.headline: Texaco hires black-owned advertising agency.

text.p: Texaco Inc, hammered in recent weeks over allegations of racial discrimination at the company, said it has hired a black-owned agency to create ads designed to improve its image among minorities.
Texaco has hired UniWorld Group to design ads that are expected to begin appearing next week in publications and on radio stations that are geared toward minority consumers.
A company spokesman said the agency was hired on November 15, the day a settlement was reached on a lawsuit involving allegations of racial discrimination.
The size of the contract with UniWorld was not immediately available.
UniWorld is headed by Chairman Byron Lewis. It has annual billings of more than $100 million, and has worked with such clients as AT&T Corp and the Lincoln/Mercury division of Ford Motor Co.
